name: MIRA final two-step research classifier

first_step.rule: P(C1)<0.5 assigns C2; otherwise proceed to step 2

second_step.input: Arithmetic mean of the eight within-sample gene percentile ranks

unlabeled_batch_calibration: Entire eligible study/assay batch, no label/outcome selection; sample SD; SD<1e-10 replaced by 1; n>=2 is computational only.
fitted_training_transformations: Separate frozen means and SDs for each component after target batch calibration
missing_input: Reject missing background genes, duplicated IDs, nonfinite required values, absent batches and singleton batches; no implicit imputation or gene mapping.
additional_genes: Ignored when outside the frozen background
single_sample: Not validated; rejected without a multi-sample batch
implementation: Numeric coefficient export; no refitting, optimization or target-label access. Generated prediction source uses base R only.
evaluation: Retrospective leave-one-cohort-out agreement with original cohort-specific labels; distinct from the pooled deployment model.
not_included: Patient-level expression, patient IDs, training labels, original fitted objects and training fit calls
